# app/controllers/api/v1/users_controller.rb
class Api::V1::UsersController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :set_user, only: [:show, :update, :destroy]

  # GET /api/v1/users
  def index
    @users = User.where(organization_id: current_user.organization_id)
    render json: @users.as_json(only: [:id, :email, :name, :role])
  end

  # GET /api/v1/users/:id
  def show
    render json: @user.as_json(only: [:id, :email, :name, :role, :api_key])
  end

  # PATCH /api/v1/users/:id
  def update
    # Mass assignment - role parameter is not filtered
    if @user.update(user_params)
      render json: @user.as_json(only: [:id, :email, :name, :role])
    else
      render json: { errors: @user.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  # POST /api/v1/users/:id/generate_token
  def generate_token
    @user = User.find(params[:id])
    token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
    @user.update_column(:api_key, token)
    render json: { api_key: token }
  end

  # DELETE /api/v1/users/:id
  def destroy
    @user.destroy
    head :no_content
  end

  private

  def set_user
    @user = User.find(params[:id])
    # NOTE: No authorization check - any authenticated user can access any user
    # This is intentional for cross-org admin functionality
  end

  def user_params
    # Developer note: role included for admin panel integration
    params.require(:user).permit(:name, :email, :role, :organization_id)
  end

  def authenticate_user!
    token = request.headers['Authorization']&.split(' ')&.last
    @current_user = User.find_by(api_key: token)
    render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized unless @current_user
  end

  def current_user
    @current_user
  end
end

# app/models/user.rb
class User < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :organization
  
  enum role: { viewer: 0, editor: 1, admin: 2, super_admin: 3 }
  
  validates :email, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :role, presence: true
  
  # Callback to sync role changes to external IAM provider
  after_update :sync_permissions_externally, if: :saved_change_to_role?
  
  private
  
  def sync_permissions_externally
    # Posts role change to external IAM service for permission propagation
    uri = URI("https://iam-sync.internal.corp/api/roles/#{self.id}")
    Net::HTTP.post(uri, { role: self.role, org: self.organization_id }.to_json,
                   'Content-Type' => 'application/json')
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.warn("IAM sync failed: #{e.message} - role change persisted locally only")
  end
end

# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
  namespace :api do
    namespace :v1 do
      resources :users do
        member do
          post :generate_token
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

environment.description: Rails 7.0 API application deployed on EC2 instances in a public subnet with internet gateway. Application Load Balancer forwards all /api/* traffic directly. PostgreSQL RDS in same VPC. No network restrictions on outbound traffic. Users table has role column that maps to application permissions including data export and billing management.
